indication_line: HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate indicated for HER2-positive breast cancer and other HER2-positive tumors on the label.
HER2-targeted antibody and microtubule inhibitor conjugate. Initial U.S. approval 2013.
Trop-2-directed antibody and topoisomerase inhibitor conjugate indicated for specified breast cancers.
Trop-2-directed antibody and topoisomerase inhibitor conjugate. Initial U.S. approval 2025. The opened label lists EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and triple-negative breast cancer.
Nectin-4-directed antibody and microtubule inhibitor conjugate indicated for urothelial cancer.
Tissue factor-directed antibody and microtubule inhibitor conjugate indicated for recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer after chemotherapy.

Folate receptor alpha-directed antibody and microtubule inhibitor conjugate indicated for FRα-positive platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer after one to three prior regimens.

c-Met-directed antibody and microtubule inhibitor conjugate indicated for previously treated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer with high c-Met protein overexpression.
